title: Completed tensor preserves compatible uniform constructible complexes
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and let $T$ be a noetherian scheme of finite dimension on which $\ell$ is invertible. Put $P_n=A/\varpi^n$ and $B=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(P_n)_T$ on the small pro-etale site. Use precisely the full subcategory $\mathcal C_A=D^b_c(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]: intrinsic derived completeness, a uniformly bounded constructible reduction tower with common local adic-lisse finite-type complex models, and compatible etale-origin witnesses. For $M,N\in\mathcal C_A$, form the ordinary derived tensor $M\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}N$ of [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent] and its Koszul completion
$$H=\Lambda(M\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}N),\qquad
\Lambda(V)=R\lim_{m\geq1}\bigl(V\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}[B\xrightarrow{\varpi^m}B]\bigr),$$
with the two-term complex in degrees $[-1,0]$, transition $\varpi$ in degree $-1$ and identity in degree $0$, and the strict-tower construction of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector]. Then $H\in\mathcal C_A$. In particular its normalized reductions admit the common local models and compatible etale-origin witnesses required by that definition, not just individually constructible cohomology.
